title: AI settings
description: Your AI API key (Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible) and tokens for agents calling MCP.

llmKey.title: My API key
llmKey.hint: AI buttons on the dashboard call the model with your own key. The key is encrypted on the server and never shown again; nobody else (not even the leader) can see it.
llmKey.loadError: Could not load your key settings.

providerHint.openai_compatible: Any OpenAI-style server: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM...

llmKey.apiKeySaved: Key {hint} is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
llmKey.apiKeySavedNoHint: A key is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
llmKey.apiKeyOptional: May be left empty if the server needs no key (e.g. Ollama).
llmKey.notSaved: No key yet. Enter a key and press Save to use AI features.
llmKey.confirmDeleteBody: AI buttons will stop working until you enter a new key. AI results already created are kept.

tokens.title: Agent tokens
tokens.hint: Personal tokens (tlp_...) that let agents such as Claude Code or Codex call TeamLens MCP with exactly your permissions.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.onlyOnce: The token is shown only once. Copy it now; if you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
tokens.confirmRevokeBody: Agents using this token will no longer be able to call MCP. This cannot be undone.

errors.llm_key_missing: No API key yet. Enter a key.
errors.llm_key_invalid: The provider rejected the API key (wrong key or no permission).
errors.llm_quota_exceeded: The provider reports quota exceeded or rate limiting. Try again later.
errors.llm_model_not_found: The provider has no such model. Check the model name.
errors.llm_timeout: The provider did not answer in time (over 60 seconds).
errors.llm_provider_error: Could not reach the provider. Check the base URL and network.
errors.llm_bad_output: The model did not return the required JSON format. Try another model.
errors.not_found: Not found (it may have been revoked).
